name.ja: 1/144 RX-78F00 ガンダム [クリアカラー]

description.ja: 『GUNDAM FACTORY YOKOHAMA』の動く実物大ガンダムの限定商品。動く“RX-78F00 ガンダム”を、トリコロールカラーの色合いに合わせたクリア成型色で立体化。
description.en: A limited edition moving life-sized Gundam from "GUNDAM FACTORY YOKOHAMA ". The moving " RX-78F00 Gundam" is made into a three-dimensional model with clear molding colors that match the tricolor color.

description.ja: • 歩行、右腕上げ、両腕あげなど動くガンダムの挙動を再現できる可動域！
description.en: • Range of motion that allows you to reproduce Gundam's movements such as walking, raising the right arm, raising both arms, etc.!

description.ja: • 動くガンダム「RX-78F00」のディティールを徹底再現。
description.en: • Thorough reproduction of the details of the moving Gundam "RX-78F00".
